name: lol-worker
description: League profile lookup backend for BrokenMeta.gg's LoL section: resolves a Riot ID live via the Riot LoL API (Account-V1, Summoner-V4, League-V4, Match-V5) and returns real rank + match-history + role/queue/activity stats. Keeps RIOT_API_KEY_LOL server-side (Cloudflare secret), never shipped to the browser. Uses a Development key for now -- see the 24h-expiry note in index.ts.
